instruction: Mohammed – There are 5 swap requests waiting. Please decide them – approve what works, decline the rest with a reason. Both people in each request need to hear the outcome. Please keep changes to a minimum. Please message everyone you move. Watch the rules – rest periods, nights in a row, the lot. Keep the cost down – no unnecessary overtime.
